rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese way to say that someone does something impolitely or rudely.

example.english: They often impolitely interrupt people when they are talking.
example.traditional: 佢成日冇禮貌咁打斷人哋講嘢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 mou5 lai5 maau6 gam3 daa2 tyun5 jan4 dei6 gong2 je5
